title: Nasdaq new all time highs! Let the Bull resume!

observed_trades.setup: Still holding Okta with good traction as cybersecurity names act well.
observed_trades.quote: Meanwhile, Okta is a name that I still have
observed_trades.notes: 00:13: 'I've got some good traction in Octa'.

observed_trades.setup: Got into AMD in recent days; it is at a new all-time high and about 140 points above his purchase. Plan is to let it work without micromanaging.
observed_trades.quote: one of the best things that I've done even these last couple days is get into AMD and now you're up, you know, 140 points from where I bought it
observed_trades.notes: Entry day and price not stated, so flagged retrospective. 05:48: 'AMD is one that I own. It's at a new all-time high'.

observed_trades.setup: Pointing at the chart: the original IBIT purchase near the lows, still held.
observed_trades.quote: a really, really nice move um and I bit since I bought it down here
observed_trades.notes: No date ('down here'). 00:13: 'I still have that I bit position'.

observed_trades.setup: Added to the IBIT position on Thursday the 17th.
observed_trades.quote: I bit since I bought it down here and then adds um on Thursday the 17th
observed_trades.notes: Caption is slightly garbled ('and then adds um on Thursday the 17th'); read as his adds to IBIT.

observed_trades.setup: Gold miners acted well, so he covered half of what was left of the GDX short as it reclaimed the 20-day; keeping a last small piece.
observed_trades.entry_basis: GDX getting back through the 20-day simple moving average (partial cover)
observed_trades.stop: will cover the last piece over 99.08 (captioned '9908') / if it takes out today's highs
observed_trades.quote: Now, mind you, I do have a GDX short. I took off half of my remaining shares as it was getting back through the 20 simple moving average
observed_trades.notes: Partial cover of a short. Cover fill price not stated; 99.08 is the stop on the remainder. 12:14: 'one that I still have short ... getting ready to cover if we take out today's highs'.

observed_trades.setup: Went long SanDisk on a small pullback just before the breakout level as memory names pushed.
observed_trades.entry_basis: pullback right before the breakout level
observed_trades.quote: So, yesterday, I get long Sandisk 1955, or excuse me, 1755
observed_trades.notes: First says 1955, corrects to 1755. Instrument not specified beyond 'Sandisk' (price level implies the stock itself, not a leveraged ETF).

observed_trades.setup: Sold SanDisk into the close the same day because it did not close well enough to hold overnight; it then ripped from the next open.
observed_trades.quote: it just doesn't close well enough for me to be able to keep. So, I get rid of it at 1758
observed_trades.notes: Same-day round trip on 2026-09-21 ('We're going into the close'). 17:19: 'get rid of SanDisk and then ... watch it rip all day long'.

observed_trades.setup: Bought ServiceNow on a morning washout and VWAP reclaim; it consolidated and closed decently, so he held it overnight.
observed_trades.entry_basis: VWAP reclaim after a morning washout
observed_trades.quote: and then NOW I had a tiny position going into the overnight session, which I saw the morning wash out yesterday and the reclaim of VWAP I get long 137s
observed_trades.notes: '137s'. 'NOW' read as ServiceNow (software context). Gapped up the next morning, then sold off.

observed_trades.setup: After the gap up, ServiceNow washed out and took out his stop; small loss, effectively a flat trade.
observed_trades.quote: I took like a little dollar loss in NOW, not a big deal whatsoever
observed_trades.notes: Stop-out is told in the second person at 08:09 ('had now it gaps up, it washes out, it stops you out'), anchored by this first-person loss statement; 17:06: 'still take a effectively a flat trade'.

observed_trades.setup: Tried Dell on the day's pullback as it reclaimed the 10-day moving average.
observed_trades.quote: I tried to buy Dell um as it was reclaiming the 10-day
observed_trades.notes: Said right after 'I liked the pullback uh today in some of the ... software names'; caption says 'Dell' although the context is software, see ambiguous_tickers.

observed_trades.setup: Did not keep Dell because the close was too weak.
observed_trades.quote: And unfortunately, she just closed too weak for me to keep
observed_trades.notes: Ticker in the preceding sentence. Same-day round trip.
